## Assignment — pre-stage polyphony migration for v4E avatar+logo → photo rename

PO chose session-12 path: pre-stage your migration so session 13 starts hot once the upstream entu/research PR lands. Dry-run only this turn; live execution is gated on (a) entu/research PR landing + (b) explicit "I authorize this run" from team-lead.

### Context

Session-12 BFF design review locked Q5 as: rename `person.avatar` → `person.photo` AND `organization.logo` → `organization.photo` in v4E to unlock Entu's native `_thumbnail` mechanism (hardcoded to look for property named exactly `photo`).

Read these BEFORE designing your script:

1. `docs/migration/findings/v4e-rename-avatar-logo-to-photo-2026-05-21.md` — the paste-ready entu/research PR draft. Sections "Proposed schema change" + "Impact on dependent code/data" describe what changes upstream + downstream.
2. `docs/architecture/bff-rights-aware-contracts.md` §0, §5.1, §10 — design context for why this rename matters.
3. Your scratchpad — manifest-first patterns from session 11 menu rationalization + session 9 Phase D class are directly applicable.

### Deliverables

**1. Discovery probe** — read-only scan of live polyphony db to enumerate exactly what's affected. Write the script under `scripts/migrations/probes/probe-rename-photo-impact-2026-05-21.ts` and the result artifact at `scripts/migrations/seed-results/probe-rename-photo-impact-<ISO-ts>.json`.

Probe must report:

- For `person.avatar`: count of person instances with `avatar` property values; for each, the value `_id` + filename + filesize (read-only).
- For `organization.logo`: same enumeration for org instances with `logo` values.
- For the type-def entities: confirm the prop-def `_id` for `person.avatar` and `organization.logo` (the entities whose `name` value will be renamed to `photo`). Capture their parent type-def entity `_id` for context.
- Anything else that looks like it would affect the rename's correctness (e.g., formulas referencing `avatar` or `logo` by name, menu items by name, type instance counts).

Run discovery LIVE today (read-only is safe) once you have credentials loaded — `set -a; . ~/.config/mvox/credentials.env; set +a`. This run does NOT require "I authorize" since it's read-only.

**2. Cleanup/migration script** — `scripts/migrations/cleanup-rename-avatar-logo-to-photo-2026-05-21.ts`. Manifest-first design:

- Build a manifest from the probe output (or from a fresh read at script start, your call — but document the choice in the script).
- Each manifest entry is one atomic operation: `{ kind: 'rename_prop_def' | 'migrate_instance_value', target_id, old_name, new_name, ...meta }`.
- Idempotent skip-on-already-renamed pattern (check current state before each op; skip if already at the target).
- Dry-run mode (`--dry-run`, default) — log every planned op without mutating. Write a JSON artifact at `scripts/migrations/seed-results/cleanup-rename-avatar-logo-to-photo-<ISO-ts>.json`.
- Live mode (`--live`, MUST NOT execute today). Refuses to run unless explicit flag passed.
- Halt-on-surprise: if any discovery mid-execution finds an entity not in the manifest, halt; do not extend the manifest mid-run.
- Wire shapes: prop-def rename = update the type-def's prop-def entity's `name` value (DELETE old value `_id` → POST new). Instance migration = for each existing value under the old property name, DELETE the old value `_id` + POST the same payload under the new property name. Per "Entu mutation-op wire shapes" (architecture-decisions.md session 8) and your session-8 PR D/E patterns.

**3. Dry-run execution** — run the cleanup script in `--dry-run` mode once the manifest is built. Land the artifact + commit on a new branch `chore/perotin-rename-photo-prestage-2026-05-21`.

### Constraints + reminders

- **NO LIVE EXECUTION this turn.** Live is gated on (a) entu/research PR merging upstream (PO submits out-of-band; session 13 confirms), (b) explicit "I authorize this run" SendMessage from team-lead. The session-9 incident codified this; the friction is the point.
- Branch convention: `chore/perotin-rename-photo-prestage-2026-05-21` from main. Verify `git branch --show-current` before every commit (L13 cross-branch slip lesson).
- If any tool hangs/prompts you for permission >30 seconds with no response, IMMEDIATELY send a status SendMessage — do not wait silently. Reference: feedback memory `feedback_agent_spawn_prompt.md` + anthropics/claude-code#61315.
- The entu/research PR has NOT been submitted yet. The script is designed against the post-rename schema; the live mutation must wait for upstream merge so we don't migrate to a name that gets revised in upstream review.
- Bentham post-write review is expected after dry-run lands; route per team-lead direction.

### Task tracking

Task #11 created. Owner = you.

### Definition of done

- Discovery probe written + executed live (read-only); artifact landed
- Cleanup script written with manifest-first design + dry-run mode
- Dry-run executed; artifact landed
- All committed on `chore/perotin-rename-photo-prestage-2026-05-21`; pushed to origin
- SendMessage report to team-lead: what the probe found, what the manifest looks like, what surprises (if any) surfaced

## RED-1 fix dispatch — Option A (split script)

Bentham RED'd commit 05eb5df cleanly. Verdict in his message (full body in your inbox).

**Routing call: Option A** — ship Layer 1 alone now, defer Layer 2 behind an empirical probe.

### Your task (task #13)

**1. Author new script:** `scripts/migrations/cleanup-rename-photo-prop-def-only-2026-05-21.ts`

Same as current `cleanup-rename-avatar-logo-to-photo-2026-05-21.ts` but:
- Drop the `buildInstanceEntries` function entirely
- Drop the `migrate_instance_value` manifest kind
- Drop the `executeMigration` function and all instance-related code paths
- Keep Layer 1: probe → manifest build (prop-defs only) → dry-run plan → live-execute (`--live` blocked) → Phase 4 `_thumbnail` smoke probe
- Update the manifest type to just `{ kind: 'rename_prop_def' | 'skip', ...meta }` — no `migrate_instance_value` variant
- Update the dry-run artifact shape accordingly (drop Layer 2 fields)
- Header comment cites the RED-1 blocker as the rationale for the split, with a forward-pointer to task #14 (deferred Layer 2 work)

**2. Delete or supersede the old script.** Your call:
- Option i: `git rm` the original `cleanup-rename-avatar-logo-to-photo-2026-05-21.ts` (clean cut)
- Option ii: rename via `git mv` + edit (preserves history but the contents are very different — diffs will be huge)
- I lean Option i (delete + create) for clarity. The blame trail still goes through the branch commit history.

**3. Fix YELLOW-12.3 cosmetic** — `probe-rename-photo-impact-2026-05-21.ts` lines 92-105: drop the dead first query in `findPropDef`. Quick win, ~3 lines.

**4. Re-run dry-run** on the Layer-1-only script; land new artifact at `scripts/migrations/seed-results/cleanup-rename-photo-prop-def-only-<ISO-ts>.json`.

**5. Commit + push** on the SAME branch `chore/perotin-rename-photo-prestage-2026-05-21`. New commit, not amend.

**6. Send for Bentham re-review** — message me when done, I'll route.

### Carryforwards (not for this turn)

- YELLOW-12.1 (probe doesn't capture md5/S3 key/content-type) — defer to task #14 (Layer 2 work)
- YELLOW-12.2 (EntuProperty interface lacks file shape) — defer to task #14
- Task #14 — file-payload probe + Layer 2 impl, gated on empirical probe of Entu file-POST semantics

### Constraints

- **No live execution.** Layer 1 alone is still gated on entu/research PR merge + PO "I authorize this run".
- **Don't rebuild Layer 2 in this PR.** That work happens after the empirical probe (task #14, future session).
- Verify `git branch --show-current` before every commit (L13 cross-branch lesson — stay on `chore/perotin-rename-photo-prestage-2026-05-21`).
- If any tool hangs/prompts you for permission >30 seconds, send a status SendMessage immediately (perm-gate trap, anthropics/claude-code#61315).
